system.description: Gold-infused anointment of all walls and portals in a room no larger than (Essence × 5) yards in any dimension. Successes (minimum 1) apply as an external penalty against Awareness rolls to detect stimuli within the room. Half this penalty (rounded up) applies against magical scrying. Celestial Exalted scrying Charms and titans add Essence extra dice to roll-offs. Lasts one day; can be sustained with maintenance rituals.
